title: 百年油田租约：为何成了，负面信号
speaker: Chris Kennedy

segments.en: Democratic transition in Venezuela will a new democratically elected government on or such a deal made 100 year lease with the US what does that signal to oil companies that are considering investing in Venezuela our personal view our view rather at Bloomberg economics is that this is a bad signal for long term investment it raises the political salience.
segments.zh: 当委内瑞拉实现民主过渡，新当选政府会否承认与美国达成的100年租约？这对考虑在委内瑞拉布局的油企释放什么信号？彭博经济认为，这对长期配置是负面信号，提高了政治敏感性。

segments.en: Likely Democrats if they take control of Congress and if they take control the White House in 2029 are going to revisit this so it adds this new layer of uncertainty undermines the timeline for a near term democratic transition and it really does you know it's a very aggressive and sort of harkening back to this older age of colonialism.
segments.zh: 如果民主党在2029年掌控国会和白宫，可能会重新审视此协议，这增加了新的不确定性，破坏了近期民主过渡的时间表，且带有激进和殖民时代色彩。

segments.en: Chris very quickly before we go that's if I were to investor I would be more concerned.
segments.zh: 克里斯，在我们结束前快速问一下，如果我是投资者，我会更担心。
